title: OXVA XLIM GO Lite Open Pod Kit
description:
The
OXVA XLIM GO Lite Open Pod Kit
is a refillable open pod system built around a 1000mAh battery with 5-30W adjustable output. It takes OXVA XLIM replacement pods, charges over USB-C and uses adjustable side airflow with an RGB battery indicator.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Pod Capacity:
2mL
Battery:
1000mAh
Output Power:
5-30W
Coil Resistance:
0.4Ω / 0.6Ω / 0.8Ω / 1.2Ω
Charging Port:
USB-C (5V/1A)
Airflow:
Adjustable side airflow
Display:
RGB battery indicator
Dimensions:
25 x 15.6 x 111mm
Weight:
42.4g
Compatible Pods:
OXVA XLIM
Brand:
OXVA
Pack Contents:
1 x XLIM GO Lite Device
1 x 0.8Ω XLIM CRC Cartridge (2mL)
1 x User Manual
Available options: Black, Mist White.
